messages:
kevin: quick heads-up: after the proxy v2 rollout, customers reported streaming stalls where clients reconnect and reprovision tokens unexpectedly. Saw cost blips in billing.
ja: saw it too. Mostly SSE long lived sessions. Pattern looks like resume accepted upstream but client got a 204 from proxy and resubscribed.
maria: logs:
```
[14:12:05] proxy-1 resume_request rid=zzx session=shard-7 forwarded
[14:12:05] billing-emitter emit resume_charge rid=zzx tokens=45
[14:12:05] proxy-1 respond 204 session=shard-7 fence=true
[14:12:06] client reconnect resubscribe start=token-0
```
sasha: UX: console only shows aggregate token usage per route. We need to bubble up an "anomalous resume" entry on route timeline with a link to trace.
leo: potential fixes: a) server-side idempotency table for resume ids (ttl 10m) b) change billing to check resume outcome before emitting charge c) adjust proxy to not respond 204 until resume flow finishes.
kevin: short term: will deploy proxy canary with small delay for 204 responses to give resume flow time. mid term: prefer server-side idempotency.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] proxy-canary us-west delayed-204 started at 1763334533
maria: opened PR for resume idempotency: https://git/redwood/streaming/+/812
sasha: making dashboard ticket DASH-1100 to add per-resume metrics and an alert when duplicate_charge_rate > 0.1% for 5m.
kevin: canary metrics look promising. duplicate_charge in canary shards dropped to 0.03%
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] Canary 5% healthy at 1763334620
kevin: will bake 30m then ramp if all good.
